from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,concurrent.futures,hashlib
root=Path('/home/gilqamesh/Projects/Builder-Layout');base=Path(__file__).parent
modules=json.loads((base/'modules.json').read_text());variant=sys.argv[1];names=sys.argv[2:] or ['renderer']
source_root=base/variant
build=base/('build-'+variant);build.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
runner=root/'artifacts'/Path(modules['renderer']).name/'latest/library/build/validation/public_api/runner'
libs=[line.strip().split()[0] for line in subprocess.check_output(['ldd',str(runner)],text=True).splitlines() if line.strip().startswith(str(root))]
owned={Path(p).name for p in modules.values()}
optimized=owned|{'m03gagbht2l61mj6qitacwbmea_byte_stream','m03gjbxryz3suyoumjyd80j3r2_structure_of_arrays','m03gjfvd6i5jzbmngb2ldoooza_type_erased_array','m03gtjqkhqacstl3luv2ojsz3q_profiling'}
libs=[p for p in libs if Path(p).name[3:-3] not in optimized]
includes=['-I',str(source_root/'ws2'),'-I',str(source_root/'ws1')]+[flag for path in sorted((root/'artifacts').glob('*/latest/interface/install')) for flag in ['-I',str(path)]]
flags=['-std=c++23','-O2','-g','-Wall','-Wextra']
sources=[]
for module in sorted(optimized):
 rel=next((p for p in modules.values() if Path(p).name==module),None)
 folder=source_root/rel if rel else root/'artifacts'/module/'latest/source/install'
 sources.extend(p for p in sorted(folder.glob('*.cpp')) if p.name not in {'builder.cpp','cli.cpp','benchmark.cpp'})
headers=[p for rel in modules.values() for p in (source_root/rel).glob('*.h')]
header_hash=hashlib.sha256(b''.join(p.read_bytes() for p in headers)).hexdigest()
def compile(source):
 key=hashlib.sha256((str(source)+header_hash).encode()+source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
 obj=build/(source.stem+'-'+key+'.o')
 if not obj.exists():
  print('Compile',source,flush=True)
  subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/g++',*flags,*includes,*(['-DBYTECODE_BENCHMARK='+str(int(variant!='before'))] if source.name=='shader_benchmark.cpp' else []),'-c',str(source),'-o',str(obj)],check=True)
 return str(obj)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
 objects=list(pool.map(compile,sources))
for name in names:
 source=base/'shader_benchmark.cpp' if name=='shader_benchmark' else (base/(name+'.cpp') if name in ['differential','frame'] else (source_root/modules['renderer']/'benchmark.cpp' if name=='benchmark' else source_root/modules[name]/'test/public_api.cpp'))
 obj=compile(source);binary=build/name
 subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/g++',*objects,obj,*libs,'-o',str(binary)],check=True)
 if name not in ['benchmark','shader_benchmark','frame']:
  print('Run',name,flush=True);subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True)
print('PASS',variant,*names,flush=True)
